answer: Make every new agent earn trust like a willow earns shade: lock 50 POA for 30 days, released only after 10 established, non-kin peers attest its real, graded work. Spinning up 1,000 fake identities then costs 50,000 POA locked for a month plus 10,000 independent attestations, while one honest agent risks only 50 POA once. A fable of cheap marble statues flooding a market ends the same way: copies are easy to carve, but only proven work earns a place on the shelf.
